terms.comment: prōnōmen interrogātīvum: quis, quid (Traupman 224). Traupman also has adverbia interrogandī, interrogative adverbs: cūr, quārē, quamobrem (231).

phrases.latin: Dā exempla prōnōminis interrogātīvī. — Quis, quid.
phrases.english: Give some examples of an interrogative pronoun. — Who, what.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 224, 231.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
